'''Pyotr Grigoryevich Gorovoy'''<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ras.ru/win/db/show_per.asp?P=.id-1665.ln-ru|title=Горовой Петр Григорьевич|work=Росси́йская акаде́мия нау́к|access-date=1 July 2026|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250223031124/https://www.ras.ru/win/db/show_per.asp?P=.id-1665.ln-ru|archive-date=23 February 2025|url-status=live|via=[[Wayback Machine]]|language=Russian}}</ref> ({{langx|ru|Пётр Григорьевич Горовой}}; 13 December 1936 – 24 June 2026) was a Russian [[Botany|botanist]]. A member of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]], he was a recipient of the [[Order of Honour (Russia)|Order of Honour]].

Gorovoy died on 24 June 2026, at the age of 89.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://piboc.dvo.ru/news/institute/3439/|title=Ушёл из жизни один из основателей нашего института академик Пётр Григорьевич ГОРОВОЙ (13.12.1936 – 24.06.2026)|work=Piboc.dvo.ru|date=25 June 2026|access-date=1 July 2026|language=Russian}}</ref>
